LanguageData.Cinder_QuickMagazine.label: quick reload
LanguageData.Cinder_QuickMagazine.description: This firearm uses a quick loading magazine.
LanguageData.Cinder_PolymerPointer.label: Polymer pointer
LanguageData.Cinder_PolymerPointer.description: This weapon is equipped with a simple polymer pointer that automatically aligns the muzzle with the target at close range, but due to its resolution issue, it can affect long-range accuracy.
LanguageData.Cinder_AntiSlipGripPiece.label: Anti slip grip piece
LanguageData.Cinder_AntiSlipGripPiece.description: This weapon is equipped with anti slip grip blades, which allows for faster firing speed.
LanguageData.Cinder_TacticalFrontGrip.label: tactical front grip
LanguageData.Cinder_TacticalFrontGrip.description: The tactical front grip on this weapon can accelerate aiming and enhance aiming accuracy, but it will also make the weapon heavier.
LanguageData.Cinder_LightBarrel.label: light barrel
LanguageData.Cinder_LightBarrel.description: This weapon uses a lightweight barrel, effectively speeding up the firing time but sacrificing accuracy.
LanguageData.Cinder_LightStock.label: light stock
LanguageData.Cinder_LightStock.description: This weapon uses a lightweight stock, which can effectively reduce weapon loading time, but it can cause difficulty in controlling recoil.
LanguageData.Cinder_LongTentacleBlade.label: tentacle sword blade
LanguageData.Cinder_LongTentacleBlade.description: This weapon has a tentacle sword blade that can effectively strike targets.
LanguageData.Cinder_UncontrollableTentacleBlade.label: uncontrollable tentacle blade
LanguageData.Cinder_UncontrollableTentacleBlade.descr: Uncontrollable tentacles have grown on this weapon, and waving them randomly affects accuracy.
LanguageData.Cinder_Choke.label: choke
LanguageData.Cinder_Choke.description: This type of firearm is equipped with a throat constriction, which makes the distribution of bullets denser and more accurate.
LanguageData.Cinder_StrongCharge.label: strong charge
LanguageData.Cinder_StrongCharge.description: The amount of gunpowder used in this gun is significantly higher than the standard, increasing its power, but it will make the firearm more difficult to control.
LanguageData.Cinder_ErosionRounds.label: erosion rounds
LanguageData.Cinder_ErosionRounds.description: This weapon uses erosion rounds to reduce the target's armor.
LanguageData.Cinder_MultiHeadedRounds.label: multi headed rounds
LanguageData.Cinder_MultiHeadedRounds.description: This weapon fires multiple headed bullets, which will cause additional wounds.
LanguageData.Cinder_EMPRounds.label: EMP rounds
LanguageData.Cinder_EMPRounds.description: This weapon fires rounds with embedded EMP capacitors, which will temporarily disable electronics and mechanoids.
LanguageData.Cinder_HollowPointRounds.label: hollow-point rounds
LanguageData.Cinder_HollowPointRounds.description: This weapon fires bullets that expand on impact, dealing more damage than normal.But the armor piercing ability has decreased.
LanguageData.Cinder_Flechette.label: flechette
LanguageData.Cinder_Flechette.description: This weapon uses flechette with stronger penetration power.
LanguageData.Cinder_HeavyPellets.label: heavy pellets
LanguageData.Cinder_HeavyPellets.description: This gun fires high-powered heavy multi headed bullets.
LanguageData.Cinder_ImprovedSights.label: tactical sight
LanguageData.Cinder_ImprovedSights.description: This weapon has a custom sight, increasing its accuracy at long range.
LanguageData.Cinder_PrecisionSights.label: Precision sight
LanguageData.Cinder_PrecisionSights.description: This weapon is equipped with bulky long-range sights, increasing its accuracy at long range.But it's difficult to aim at the target at close range.
LanguageData.Cinder_ShoddySights.label: shoddy sights
LanguageData.Cinder_ShoddySights.description: Defects in this weapon's sights decrease its accuracy at long ranges.
LanguageData.Cinder_PrecisionScope.label: tracking scope
LanguageData.Cinder_PrecisionScope.description: This weapon's scope uses target recognition software to automate target tracking, making it faster to fire.But it will reduce the range slightly
LanguageData.Cinder_RangefinderScope.label: rangefinder
LanguageData.Cinder_RangefinderScope.description: This weapon's scope contains an advanced rangefinder, allowing it to fire further.
LanguageData.Cinder_RapidFire.label: rapid fire
LanguageData.Cinder_RapidFire.description: This weapon contains an improved self-loading mechanism. When firing bursts of multiple rounds, the time between each round is dramatically reduced.But making weapons difficult to control.
LanguageData.Cinder_HeavyReceiver.label: heavy receiver
LanguageData.Cinder_HeavyReceiver.description: This weapon uses a heavy receiver, which slows down the firing rate but is beneficial for firearm control.
LanguageData.Cinder_ExtendedMagazine.label: extended magazine
LanguageData.Cinder_ExtendedMagazine.description: This weapon fires 20% more shots in a single burst than normal.
LanguageData.Cinder_ShortedMagazine.label: shorted magazine
LanguageData.Cinder_ShortedMagazine.description: This weapon fires 33% less shots in a single burst than normal.But it can improve the loading speed.
LanguageData.Cinder_RapidMedication.label: rapid medication
LanguageData.Cinder_RapidMedication.description: This gourd contains a fast potion that can make tentacles attack faster.
LanguageData.Cinder_ErosionMedication.label: erosion medication
LanguageData.Cinder_ErosionMedication.description: This gourd contains a potion that can disable the target's erosion.
LanguageData.Cinder_StrengtheningMedication.label: strengthening medication
LanguageData.Cinder_StrengtheningMedication.descripti: The tentacles of this gourd will be stronger.
LanguageData.Cinder_ImprovedLoadingSystem.label: Improved loading system
LanguageData.Cinder_ImprovedLoadingSystem.description: The loading system of this weapon has been improved, and whether in rocket or rapid fire machine gun mode, it can complete enemy reconnaissance and reloading faster.
LanguageData.Cinder_HeavyAmmunition.label: heavy ammunition
LanguageData.Cinder_HeavyAmmunition.description: This weapon uses heavier rocket and machine gun rounds, which can cause higher damage and armor piercing, but the weight of the weapon has increased.
LanguageData.Cinder_ExtraGreatSword.label: extra great sword
LanguageData.Cinder_ExtraGreatSword.description: This weapon is equipped with the "extra great sword" large caliber ammunition, which greatly enhances its power while reducing its firing rate.
LanguageData.Cinder_SwiftSword.label: swift sword
LanguageData.Cinder_SwiftSword.description: This weapon is equipped with a lightweight structure called "Swift Sword" and uses reduced charge ammunition, which can shoot faster and more accurately, but its power has been reduced.
LanguageData.Cinder_Ornamental.label: ornamental
LanguageData.Cinder_Ornamental.description: This weapon was crafted for aesthetics over functionality. It deals less damage but looks great.
LanguageData.Cinder_Ugly.label: ugly
LanguageData.Cinder_Ugly.description: This weapon was crafted with no respect for aesthetics. It looks like junk but gets the job done. Traders will pay less for it.
LanguageData.Cinder_Cumbersome.label: cumbersome
LanguageData.Cinder_Cumbersome.description: This weapon is unwieldy to use, making it slower to aim.
LanguageData.Cinder_GridTentacle.label: grid tentacle
LanguageData.Cinder_GridTentacle.description: The tentacles of this weapon can flexibly strike enemies.
LanguageData.Cinder_Lightweight.label: lightweight
LanguageData.Cinder_Lightweight.description: This weapon is much lighter than normal, lowering its aiming time.
